pli-tv-pvr2.10:1.3: Avassutā bhikkhunī avassutassa purisapuggalassa adhakkhakaṃ ubbhajāṇumaṇḍalaṃ gahaṇaṃ sādiyati, āpatti pārājikassa;
pli-tv-pvr2.10:1.4: bhikkhu kāyena kāyaṃ āmasati, āpatti saṅghādisesassa;
pli-tv-pvr2.10:1.8: kāyasaṃsaggaṃ sādiyanapaccayā imā pañca āpattiyo āpajjati.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:2.3: Bhikkhunī jānaṃ pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicchādeti, āpatti pārājikassa;
pli-tv-pvr2.10:3.1: Yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjanapaccayā kati āpattiyo āpajjati?
pli-tv-pvr2.10:3.2: Yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjanapaccayā pañca āpattiyo āpajjati.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:3.3: Ukkhittānuvattikā bhikkhunī yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjati, ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ;
pli-tv-pvr2.10:3.6: bhedakānuvattikā bhikkhunī yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjati, āpatti saṅghādisesassa;
pli-tv-pvr2.10:3.7: pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjati, āpatti pācittiyassa –
pli-tv-pvr2.10:3.8: yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjanapaccayā imā pañca āpattiyo āpajjati.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:4.1: Aṭṭhamaṃ vatthuṃ paripūraṇapaccayā kati āpattiyo āpajjati?
pli-tv-pvr2.10:4.2: Aṭṭhamaṃ vatthuṃ paripūraṇapaccayā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:4.3: Purisena – ‘‘itthannāmaṃ okāsaṃ āgacchā’’ti vuttā gacchati, āpatti dukkaṭassa;
pli-tv-pvr2.10:4.6: aṭṭhamaṃ vatthuṃ paripūraṇapaccayā imā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:5.1: Ussayavādikā bhikkhunī aḍḍaṃ karaṇapaccayā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:7.1: Ekā gāmantaraṃ gamanapaccayā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:7.3: paṭhamaṃ pādaṃ parikkhepaṃ atikkāmeti, āpatti thullaccayassa;
pli-tv-pvr2.10:8.1: Samaggena saṅghena ukkhittaṃ bhikkhuniṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anapaloketvā kārakasaṅghaṃ anaññāya gaṇassa chandaṃ osāraṇapaccayā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:9.1: Avassutā bhikkhunī avassutassa purisapuggalassa hatthato khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā bhuñjanapaccayā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:10.1: ‘‘Kiṃ te, ayye, eso purisapuggalo karissati avassuto vā anavassuto vā, yato tvaṃ anavassutā! Iṅgha, ayye, yaṃ te eso purisapuggalo deti khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā taṃ tvaṃ sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khāda vā bhuñja vā’’ti, uyyojanapaccayā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:10.2: Tassā vacanena khādissāmi bhuñjissāmīti paṭiggaṇhāti, āpatti dukkaṭassa;
pli-tv-pvr2.10:11.1: Kupitā bhikkhunī yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjanapaccayā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:12.1: Kismiñcideva adhikaraṇe paccākatā bhikkhunī yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjanapaccayā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:13.1: Saṃsaṭṭhā bhikkhunī yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjanapaccayā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:14.1: ‘‘Saṃsaṭṭhāva, ayye, tumhe viharatha, mā tumhe nānā viharitthā’’ti uyyojentī yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjanapaccayā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:17.1: Dadhiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjanapaccayā kati āpattiyo āpajjati?
pli-tv-pvr2.10:17.2: Dadhiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjanapaccayā dve āpattiyo āpajjati.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:17.5: dadhiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjanapaccayā imā dve āpattiyo āpajjati.
